title: Keep the stewardship people and the tags out of a published graph
description: A house schema for the x-manni-kg-output tests. `concepts` is marked false because it is the one harvested page-level field that reaches all four published outputs; `owner` stands for the stewardship fields proposal 0051 recommends marking. The mark nested under `kg` is there to be ignored, as 0047 rule 2 ignores a nested x-manni-location.
